parts: On Tuesday, May 24, 2011 at 4:12 PM, Nick S wrote:

Is started out with (what I thought was) a simple task...to produce a
correlation plot of two variables. I keep getting an error when trying
to plot the data and am at a loss for solving the issue.

My Data:

results = structure(list(OD260 = c(2.547, 2.627, 2.345, 2.412, 2.127,
2.908,
2.238, 3.32, 3.212, 1.952, 2.24, 3.312, 2.991, 2.627, 3.198,
2.773, 2.54, 1.501, 2.83, 2.932, 2.46, 2.38, 2.731, 2.575, 3.045,
2.347, 2.924, 3.255, 2.401, 3.099, 3.203, 3.27, 2.838, 2.367,

0.6375, 0.4, 0.525, 0.6625, 0.475, 0.4, 0.425, 0.3625, 0.6125,
0.5625, 0.675, 0.4125, 0.7, 0.4125, 0.675, 0.4, 0.6375, 0.3875,
0.5125, 0.65, 0.525, 0.475, 0.4375, 0.3625, 0.625, 0.3375, 0.2625,
0.6, 0.4375, 0.425, 0.5625, 0.3625, 0.4125, 0.3625, 0.5125, 0.6375,
0.2875, 0.425, 0.575, 0.5625, 0.5875, 0.6625, 0.3625, 0.4875,
0.6375, 0.4625, 0.45, 0.3375, 0.4)), .Names = c("OD260", "GC"
), row.names = c(NA, 50L), class = "data.frame")

ggplot(results, aes(x = GC, y = OD260)) + geom_point()
Error in get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
attempt to apply non-function

Can anyone explain what I am doing wrong?
